title: Fixed irrigation split/retry candidate-state identity

source.snapshot: SWAP5 existing typed candidate evaluator, source-bound by prior PPA-IRR-FIXED-APPLICATION
source.branches: active-event event-end split_required and exact event-end completion

scope: oversized interval returns SPLIT_REQUIRED with unchanged candidate state and no materialized flux
exact retry to requested split endpoint matches a direct event-sized interval in candidate state and flux result
100000 deterministic valid fixed events with duration no greater than one day
non_goals: solver transaction acceptance/rejection, external top-boundary binding or rollback beyond candidate immutability
scheduled irrigation, event-calendar ingestion, accepted mass, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: oversized interval is fail-closed and does not advance the candidate event index
exact retry and direct interval produce bitwise-identical materialized event and candidate state
100000 deterministic cases pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
